_readme: The public build (python3 build.py --public -> dist/public/index.html). 'notice' is what it says about itself; 'forbidden' is what the build refuses to publish: 'everywhere' words searched in the whole file, 'in_data' patterns searched in the embedded data.

notice.long: Unofficial map, made by a community volunteer. Sizes and positions are approximate and the festival set-up can still change: the printed map is the official one.
notice.credits: Typefaces: Mozilla Headline, Mozilla Text and IBM Plex Mono, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. 3D: three.js, MIT licence.
